🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(ts_mean(divide(abs(ts_pct(close, 1)), volume), 20), ts_std(ts_pct(close, 1), 20)), 20)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean(divide(abs(ts_pct(close, 1)), volume), 20), ts_std(ts_pct(close, 1), 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(abs(ts_pct(close, 1)), volume), 20)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(abs(ts_pct(close, 1)), volume)
  5. 5. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(ts_pct(close, 1))
  6. 6. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(close, 1)
  7. 7. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(close, 1), 20)
  8. 8. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(close, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 high：high
  4. 计算 low：low
  5. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
  6. 计算 abs_ret：ret.abs()
  7. 计算 impact：abs_ret / volume
  8. 计算 window：40
  9. 计算 avg_impact：impact.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
  10. 计算 vol：ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1)
  11. 计算 base_factor：avg_impact / vol
  12. 计算 vwap：(volume * (high + low + close) / 3).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum() / volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
  13. 计算 up_vol：volume * (close > vwap).astype(float)
  14. 计算 down_vol：volume * (close < vwap).astype(float)
  15. 计算 up_sum：up_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
  16. 计算 down_sum：down_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
  17. 计算 asymmetry：(down_sum - up_sum) / (down_sum + up_sum)
  18. 计算 factor：base_factor * (1.0 + asymmetry)
  19. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0 abs_ret = ret.abs() impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan) window = 40 avg_impact = impact.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean() vol = ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan) base_factor = avg_impact / vol vwap = (volume * (high + low + close) / 3).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum() / volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum() up_vol = volume * (close > vwap).astype(float) down_vol = volume * (close < vwap).astype(float) up_sum = up_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum() down_sum = down_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum() asymmetry = (down_sum - up_sum) / (down_sum + up_sum).replace(0, np.nan) factor = base_factor * (1.0 + asymmetry.fillna(0)) factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_smoothed'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_smoothed']
